outlet: Walla Walla Union-Bulletin, "Columbia County commissioners appoint interim prosecuting attorney to begin in November" (Erick Bengel, 2025-09-23)
notes: Commissioners appointed Nickolas Ward (Clarkston private practice, former Asotin County deputy prosecutor, Marine Corps veteran) on Sept. 22, 2025, to finish Dale Slack's term from Nov. 1; Ward was the only formal applicant; first goal to open the office to the public.
